live.name: Cron
live.headline: Cron: a threat actor known from a catalogue entry and four tool names
live.in_short: Cron is listed in the ETDA catalogue with four associated tools. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: Cron is a threat actor listed in the ETDA catalogue, which records no other names for it.
The catalogue lists four tools tied to Cron: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot.
No public report in this library describes its operations.

next.name: Cron
next.headline: Cron: a thinly documented actor known mainly through four named tools
next.in_short: The catalogue lists Cron with four tools and no aliases. No fact card in this library describes the actor's activity, so this profile is a stub.

sentences.t: The catalogue record lists this actor under the name Cron.
The entry comes from the ETDA threat actor encyclopedia.
The record names four tools: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot.
Treat this entry as a pointer only. Check primary vendor reporting on the named tools before drawing any conclusion about who Cron is or what it does.
Take care not to confuse this actor with the ordinary Linux cron scheduler, which many unrelated reports mention.
